def test(extra,const,name):
    def vp(p):
        cols=[np.exp(-p[0]*x**2),(t**2/(1+p[1]*t**2))*v**3]+extra
        if const: cols.append(np.ones_like(t))
        A=np.column_stack(cols); c=lstsq(A,a,rcond=None)[0]
        return a-A@c
    bl=None

        r=least_squares(vp,s,bounds=([1e-3,1e-4],[10,20]))
        nm=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(a)
        if bl is None or nm<bl[0]: bl=(nm,np.round(r.x,4))
    print(name,bl)
